metrics.description: Per-player page panels, two-figure Nightingale rose, availability projection and recent match log.
metrics.formula: Document envelope: player totals, playing time, role evidence, position stats, the published rose axes, the curated availability projection and the latest competitive match rows for one player. The rose uses league-only rates from the provider season totals; each percentile is the midrank rank of the raw value in the player's league and role cohort (provider-group fallback), with conceded_p90 ranked on negated values. The percentile is null when the cohort or value is unavailable. Where current-season Premiership minutes are below the squad threshold, the rose uses the most recent prior Premiership season with at least 180 league minutes and a same-season cohort; season_used, cohort_season, fallback and fallback_note are published and visible. The summary minutes remain current-season. The match log is a projection of the normalized player-match rows joined to the fixture date, opponent and score; it is not recomputed in React.

limitations: Player page rows; provenance checked, not recomputed.

Availability is the curated ledger projection, not an inferred injury.

metrics.confidence_rule: Declared by the payload fields and the source row; see docs/methodology.md.
metrics.description: Team-match expected goals from open-play shot zones, shots on target, blocked shots and penalties; a model range, a goals range, provider-xG calibration, transfer check, provider-style estimate, manager splits, aggregates and coverage.
metrics.formula: open_play_sot = max(0, shots_on_target - penalty_sot_subtracted); open_play_insidebox = max(0, shots_insidebox - penalty_attempts); fxG_open = a selected linear model on open-play inside-box, outside-box, shots on target, off-target and blocked counts; fxG = fxG_open + 0.76 * penalty_attempts. Coefficients are fitted by OLS to 2026-27 Premiership team rows where provider xG exists. The 80% model range is the 10th-90th percentile of match-clustered bootstrap predictions plus the leave-one-match-out residual pool. The 80% goals range is the convolution of a beta-binomial open-play distribution and a binomial penalty distribution. Aggregate variances are combined, never summed as intervals. provider_estimate = max(0, intercept + slope * fxg) for rows without provider xG; actual and estimated provider values are never summed. manager_splits sum league match rows by date-attributed manager stint, for and against separately.
metrics.label: fxG document
limitations: fxG is a team-match estimate from shots, shot zones and penalties. It is not a location model, not xGOT and not provider xG. The record has no shot coordinates, distance, angle, body part, pressure or goalkeeper position.

The coefficients are calibrated to 2026-27 football-data provider xG. The gate is leave-one-match-out inside that season; the 2025-26 API-Football check crosses season and provider and is informational, not a clean holdout.
Penalties are priced at a fixed 0.76 xG and removed from open-play counts. Own goals, deflections and shootouts are outside the model.

The two ranges answer different questions. Neither is a confidence interval for team quality, a result prediction or proof of finishing skill. A discrete goals range can cover more than its nominal level.
The provider-style estimate is a separate calibration for rows without provider xG, not provider xG itself.

metrics.confidence_rule: Requires a published fxG and a positive shot count; otherwise unavailable.
metrics.description: Expected goals divided by shots for a team match or aggregate.
metrics.formula: fxg_per_shot = fxg / shots; null when shots is zero or unavailable.
metrics.label: xG per shot
limitations: Penalties are included in the numerator and denominator; the value is a descriptive scale, not a shot-level probability.

metrics.confidence_rule: Requires a published fxG and goals; the range is descriptive.
metrics.description: Observed goals minus the team-match fxG estimate, with a shifted goals range.
metrics.formula: goals_minus_fxg = goals - fxg. The shifted goals range is goals_low - fxg to goals_high - fxg.
metrics.label: Goals minus fxG
limitations: One match or one season is not proof of finishing skill; overperformance usually regresses and style changes the chance profile.

metrics.confidence_rule: Requires fitted coefficients and a valid bootstrap; otherwise residual-only or unavailable.
metrics.description: The 80% range for the fxG estimate.
metrics.formula: 10th-90th percentile of match-clustered bootstrap predictions plus a draw from the leave-one-match-out residual pool. Aggregates sum per draw; per-match ranges are never summed as intervals.
metrics.label: fxG model range
limitations: This is model uncertainty, not a result prediction or a confidence interval for team quality.

metrics.confidence_rule: Requires shot and penalty counts; a discrete range can cover more than its nominal level.
metrics.description: The 80% range of goals from the same chances.
metrics.formula: Convolution of a beta-binomial open-play goal distribution and a binomial penalty distribution; aggregate distributions are convolved across matches. The range is the 10th-90th percentile.
metrics.label: Goals range
limitations: Shot quality is heterogeneous; the binomial approximation is conservative.
The range is not a prediction of the score and not a verdict on finishing.

metrics.confidence_rule: Requires provider statistics; missing classes are unavailable.
metrics.description: Measured shots, shots on target, off-target, blocked, inside-box, outside-box and penalty counts behind a team-match fxG value.
metrics.formula: Counts are carried from the licensed team statistics and event feed; missing values are null, never zero.
metrics.label: fxG shot profile
limitations: Provider shot counts can disagree slightly across sources; the source row is named on the match page.

metrics.confidence_rule: Complete for every season with an API fixture record; the coverage table lists missing seasons.
metrics.description: Cormack-era defeats by four or more goals, newest first.
metrics.formula: goals_for/goals_against are the final score for each defeat with a margin of four or more; one row per fixture, newest first; the threshold is a display parameter, not a modelled value.
metrics.label: Heavy defeats
limitations: The four-goal threshold is a presentation choice; the match page carries the full score and record.

metrics.confidence_rule: Published only where the provider value exists and the player has at least 450 minutes; cohorts must meet their minimum or the percentile is null. Unknown is never zero.
metrics.denominator: minutes; passes_total; duels_total; dribbles_attempts; shots_total; saves + conceded
metrics.description: One row per ranked player per league with provider season statistics, within-league role percentiles and profile scores.
metrics.formula: Per-90 values are stat * 90 / minutes. Completed passes are passes_total * pass_accuracy / 100. Duel and dribble percentages divide by their provider attempts; conversion divides goals by shots; save percentage divides saves by saves + conceded. The rating percentile is the midrank percentile of the provider rating within the league and role family at 450+ minutes; the provider-group fallback is used only when the role cohort is below its minimum. Archetype scores are 100 * Phi(sum(w * shrunk robust z) / sum(abs(w))), with winsorisation at 1/99, median/MAD scaling, minutes shrinkage and weight renormalisation. The rose uses the same league-only rates: each axis is the midrank percentile of the raw value in the same role-family cohort (provider group fallback), with conceded_p90 ranked on negated values. Missing values and insufficient cohorts are null.
metrics.label: Scouting player pool
limitations: Provider ratings are opaque and relative to a league and role cohort; no cross-league ranking is published.
The feed has no xG/xA, progressive passes, carries, pressures, aerial wins or crosses, so those features are absent rather than inferred.
Role families need starting-XI grids; leagues without grids use the provider position group and say so.
Scouting priority is an Aberdeen preference, not a measured quality term.
The current club comes from the provider transfer feed; the stats club is kept where it differs. A subsequent move outside a pool team may be missing.
Rose percentiles are within the league and role cohort, not a cross-league rank. A missing or insufficient cohort is null, never zero.

metrics.confidence_rule: A family is not ranked without a qualifying cohort; availability is used only from the verified ledger. The reading is evidence, not a medical or selection verdict.
metrics.description: Aberdeen role-family ratings against the Scottish Premiership cohort, with verified availability evidence.
metrics.formula: The family average is the appearance-weighted mean provider rating of Aberdeen players at 300+ competitive minutes in the role family. The percentile is the midrank position of that average within the other Premiership players in the same role family at 450+ minutes; Aberdeen are excluded from their own cohort. The reading is structural below 40, at 40-60, above 60; a below-cohort family with one absent first-choice player is cover, two or more is hold. First-choice evidence is 10 starts or 900 minutes in the most recent prior season with at least 450 minutes.
metrics.label: Scouting weakness board
limitations: The model cannot separate selection, availability and quality.
The provider rating is not a verdict; the cohort is the other Premiership players in the same role family, not a like-for-like cross-league pool.
Only verified official AFC team news can mark a player out or available.

metrics.confidence_rule: A profile is published only for its applicable role families and with at least 70% of the absolute weight present; otherwise null.
metrics.description: Weighted player-profile scores, their feature weights, coverage, the attacker assist/goal split and the dedicated goal-scoring list.
metrics.formula: Each archetype is a weighted composite of winsorised, robust z-scores within league and role family: z = (x - median) / (1.4826 * MAD), shrunk by minutes / (minutes + 450), combined with signed weights and mapped to 0-100 by the normal CDF. Missing features are removed and the remaining absolute weights renormalised; below 70% coverage the score is null. Weights are in config/scouting/archetypes.yaml and are published with the score.
metrics.label: Scouting archetype profiles
limitations: A profile is not a position, a target or a recommendation.

Assist bias and goal bias are separate attacker profiles. Each leader list is ordered by its own adjusted profile score multiplied by the U23 and European preferences; the goal-scoring table is ordered by goals per 90, not by a composite.
The assist profile weights passes, key passes, pass accuracy and dribbles. The feed carries no crosses or chance-creation data, so those are absent rather than inferred.
The goal profile deliberately excludes pass and dribble volume so it does not reproduce the assist order.

metrics.confidence_rule: Published only where the league table and team row exist; missing standings are unknown. The lift is a contrast, not a valuation, forecast or recommendation.
metrics.description: Players outperforming teams that are underperforming in their league.
metrics.formula: Team points per game = points / played in the provider's current league table. The team points percentile is the midrank percentile of that value among the league's teams. team_lift = player role-adjusted percentile - team points percentile. A team is underperforming when its percentile is at or below the configured maximum (default 40). The lens keeps players with a positive lift at those teams, ordered by lift then scouting priority. A league without a table is unknown, never zero-strength.
metrics.label: Scouting team-context lens
limitations: Team underperformance is a within-league points-per-game contrast, not a budget, wage or resource model.
A player's role-adjusted percentile and a team's points percentile are different units; the lift is a descriptive ranking aid, not a causal claim.
A league without a current table is unknown, not zero-strength.

metrics.confidence_rule: A player is listed at 180+ competitive minutes; a missing provider value is null, never zero.
metrics.description: Aberdeen registered-squad position-specific per-90 output, competitive matches only.
metrics.formula: The same per-90 and percentage formulas as scouting.pool, applied to the registered Aberdeen squad in competitive matches only (friendlies and loan-club rows excluded), at 180+ minutes. The rating is appearance-weighted; the percentile is within the Premiership role cohort. The rose uses Premiership-only rates against the same league and role cohort.
metrics.label: Scouting squad profile
limitations: Forward and progressive passes, carries and pressures are not in the feed; they are unavailable, not inferred.
Loanees out are excluded; their loan-club rows are not Aberdeen output.

metrics.confidence_rule: Every league reports what the provider returned; an empty response is labelled, not zero-filled.
metrics.description: Per-league provider coverage, role coverage and pool counts.
metrics.formula: Counts of provider player-season rows, rated rows, rows at 450+ minutes, players with at least one starting-XI role, played fixtures and lineups fetched. Role coverage is role players divided by the league pool. Searchable requires at least 25 rated players.
metrics.label: Scouting coverage
limitations: Coverage is a provider fact at the last sync, not a permanent statement.
Scottish lower tiers have lineups but no player season statistics.
Current-club coverage comes from the team transfer feed and may miss a later move outside a pool team.

metrics.confidence_rule: The index is published only with at least 70% of the weight present. The GBP band is published only when the anchor gate passes; the gate requires 60 usable anchors, role, tier and age coverage. A missing band is null, never zero.
metrics.description: The 0-100 scouting value index and the anchor-gated GBP value model.
metrics.formula: Value index = 100 * sum(w_i * component_i) / sum(w_i) over performance (league-adjusted percentile / 100), age curve, minutes reliability (min(1, minutes / 1800)) and best adjusted profile score / 100. Weights are renormalised over available components and the index is null below 70% coverage. The GBP band is fitted only after the public-source anchor gate passes: log(value_gbp) = b0 + b1*adjusted_percentile/100 + b2*age + b3*age^2 + b4*log(minutes) + role-group dummies. The published band is the 80% prediction interval. No GBP value is published before the gate.
metrics.label: Scouting value model
limitations: The value index is a scouting ordering, not a transfer value or fee.
The GBP band is not published until the public-source anchor register passes the gate; it is never an uncalibrated currency estimate.
Contract length, wages, release clauses and agent fees are unknown.

metrics.confidence_rule: Priority is published only where the value index exists. European status unknown is never discounted. The weight is a scouting preference, not a measured quality equivalence.
metrics.description: U23 and European shop-window weighting on top of the value index.
metrics.formula: scouting_priority = value_index * age_multiplier * europe_multiplier. age_multiplier = u23_multiplier when age <= u23_max_age, else 1.0. europe_multiplier = europe_multiplier when european league-phase minutes >= europe_minutes_threshold, else 1.0. The European flag is built from the league-phase fixtures of the Champions League, Europa League and Conference League and the per-fixture player endpoint; qualifiers and play-offs are excluded. A player not found is none only when coverage is complete; otherwise the status is unknown and the multiplier is 1.0.
metrics.label: Scouting priority
limitations: The U23 boost and the European shop-window discount are Aberdeen scouting preferences, not measured quality.
Only the league phase of the three UEFA competitions is used; qualifiers, play-offs and domestic Europe are not.
A player with fewer than 90 league-phase minutes is shown but not discounted. Unknown European status is not discounted.
Priority is not a transfer value or a fee.

value.note: Manual calibration may use restricted pages as a private sanity check only; no restricted value, URL or scraped table is published. Every inferred output is a range with a confidence label.

cutoffs.label: European places · 1–3
cutoffs.note: 4th is conditional on the Scottish Cup winner already being in the top three.

cutoffs.label: Top-six / bottom-six split
cutoffs.note: The league splits after 33 matches; the bottom six cannot finish higher than 7th.

cutoffs.label: Relegation play-off · 11th
cutoffs.note: 11th plays the Championship play-off winner over two legs.

value.name: Scottish Premiership
value.qualification_note: Scotland has four UEFA places for 2027/28: the champions enter the Champions League second qualifying round, the Scottish Cup winner enters the Europa League first qualifying round, and 2nd and 3rd enter the Conference League second qualifying round. 4th only qualifies if the Scottish Cup winner is already in the top three. The League Cup carries no European place. Subject to the final UEFA access list and cup outcomes.

cutoffs.label: Promotion play-off · 2nd–4th
cutoffs.note: 2nd–4th enter the Premiership play-off with 11th in the Premiership.

cutoffs.label: Relegation play-off · 9th
cutoffs.note: 9th enters the Championship/League One play-off with 2nd–4th in League One.

value.name: Scottish Championship
value.qualification_note: 1st is promoted automatically. 2nd–4th enter the Premiership play-off with 11th in the Premiership. 9th enters the Championship/League One play-off, and 10th is relegated to League One.

cutoffs.label: Promotion play-off · 2nd–4th
cutoffs.note: 2nd–4th enter the Championship/League One play-off with 9th in the Championship.

cutoffs.label: Relegation play-off · 9th
cutoffs.note: 9th enters the League One/League Two play-off with 2nd–4th in League Two.

value.name: Scottish League One
value.qualification_note: 1st is promoted automatically. 2nd–4th enter the Championship play-off with 9th in the Championship. 9th enters the League One/League Two play-off, and 10th is relegated to League Two.

cutoffs.label: Promotion play-off · 2nd–4th
cutoffs.note: 2nd–4th enter the League One/League Two play-off with 9th in League One.

cutoffs.label: Pyramid play-off · 10th
cutoffs.note: 10th faces the tier-five group winner; no automatic relegation.

value.name: Scottish League Two
value.qualification_note: 1st is promoted automatically. 2nd–4th enter the League One play-off with 9th in League One. 10th enters the pyramid play-off against the winner of the Highland / Lowland East / Lowland West champions' group; there is no automatic relegation, and the League Two club hosts the second leg.

penalty.source: fixed historical penalty conversion prior; see docs/xg.md

value.note: A team is treated as underperforming when its points-per-game percentile is at or below the threshold. A player must have a positive lift. Empty leagues or teams without a current table stay unknown, never zero-strength.
